notes.title: Demo Updated with new systems and polishing!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey yo! Akumers![/p][p][/p][p]We just updated the Demo with a bunch of new systems. 

Let us know if there's anything else you want at [b]team@sensengames.com[/b] or post it on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3692360/discussions/0/838346066654925860/"]feedback discussion[/url].[/p][p][/p][h1]What's in this Update[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Badges System[/b][/h2][p]Now, depending on your highscore you get a badge! If you're still at the beginning you'll get something like [b]Noob Gamer[/b], but if you're experienced you'll get [b]Veteran Gamer[/b] or better! So now you can prove your skills by getting higher badges![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/27fd279f68285efad3a0497fe9c205df7b5d9bc1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/3db6770457600dd8cb86691c3a373f67540f7499.png"][/img][/p][h2]
[b]Unlockable Tips System[/b][/h2][p]We know that is fun to discover stuff on your own! But we also know that nobody likes to get stuck, so if you want to get some tips you can reach the [b]Expert Tips[/b] menu. But most of them are only unlockable when reaching a minimum level of score, so you also have to make the effort![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/a95367ecea339fe77bd4c05117bd4ae2532625b9.gif"][/img][/p][h2]
[b]Notification-like System[/b][/h2][p]Know when a new tip or a new badge was unlocked instantly while playing![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/a1cc856ae82157ac9569a8f8b94d5716223971a7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Tutorial System[/h1][p]The first time you play the game we'll have some instructions about the basic commands of the game! So you can start knowing at least the basics![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/df29a4466a8a3985a16d413b4dea485c70ec2707.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Damage & Score popups[/h1][p]Know how much damage and score you received in each kill![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/6ad5f60be7893631d7fc6f247cfdc39895d8669d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Damage & Health Feedback[/h1][p]Know the screen gets red an unfocused when you take a hit! Depending on how have it was, the effects will get worse! This way the damage feels heavier! Also when the health is low you get a heartbeat SFX and other effects as well![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/bf0965df3c9941bc0c1ec950c83646382b6676cc.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you like the updates![/p][p]Thanks for following us![/p]

notes.title: Demo Updated with settings for Audio, Graphics, and Gameplay
notes.notes: [p]Hey yo![/p][p][/p][p]We just updated the Demo with settings. We added everything we think is most important. [/p][p]Let us know if there's anything else you want at [b]team@sensengames.com[/b] or post it on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3692360/discussions/0/838346066654925860/"]feedback discussion[/url].[/p][p][/p][h1]All settings added on this update[/h1][h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Mouse sensitity (x and y)[/p][/*][*][p]Invert mouse (x and y)[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Master Volume[/p][/*][*][p]Music Volume[/p][/*][*][p]Sound Effects Volume[/p][/*][*][p]Voice Volume[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Graphics[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Screen Mode: Exclusive Fullscreen / Fullscreen Window / Windowed / Maximazed Window[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution: 1920x1080, 1024x768, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Display: Which monitor you want the game to be[/p][/*][*][p]VSync: On/Off[/p][/*][*][p]Framerate Limit: Unlimited / 30 / 60 / 120[/p][/*][*][p]FIeld of view (FOV): 60 ~ 120[/p][/*][*][p]Brightness: -100 ~ 100[/p][/*][*][p]Contrast: -100 ~ 100[/p][/*][*][p]Gamma: -100 ~ 100[/p][/*][*][p]Screenshake: On / Off[/p][/*][*][p]Dash Effects: On / Off[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Future updates planned for the demo[/h1][list][*][p]Hints about the game mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad support[/p][/*][*][p]Keyrebinding[/p][/*][*][p]Localization[/p][/*][*][p]More polishing[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Screenshots[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/3d124d36c233aca3f98e07f71d703063121f36b3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/77e214f5a42e6dac0b53487a3c2e78f0c1a36ea8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639130/9bf82b998803ed5d34de6bf7828f07aa6bc47642.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for following us![/p]
